title: Household Timekeeping Stability Survey — Enrollment Administration
summary: Current protocol-administration record for the Household Timekeeping Stability Survey and its fourteen-day observation schedule.

sections.title: ADMINISTRATIVE RECORD
sections.body:
**Study reference:** ST-26-021

**Protocol revision:** 1.2

**Responsible unit:** Participant Programs Office

**Administrative state:** Participation open

**Effective date:** 2026-08-04

**Personnel record:** Role-only working copy

sections.title: PURPOSE & SCOPE
sections.body:
**Objective:** Maintain the approved public protocol and schedule-eligibility screen for broad, non-identifying observations of ordinary household time displays.

**Scope limitation:** This administrative copy contains no enrollment record, household address, account information, device identity, photographs, or individual readings.

sections.title: METHOD & OBSERVATIONS
sections.body:
**Administrative review:** Confirmed the twice-weekly observation schedule, broad display categories, and instruction to leave missed observations blank.

**Observation:** Public eligibility fields remain limited to age confirmation, display availability, and schedule suitability. The study does not request network-connected device data.

sections.title: DISPOSITION
sections.body:
**Disposition:** Continue the current eligibility screen and fourteen-day protocol materials.

**Next review:** Recheck observation-window wording at the next scheduled revision.

**Review status:** Current materials approved for public display.
